runtime_profile.profile_owner: unchanged local::probe_local_runtime and default common attempt admission; runtime facts checked for every observation

classification_rules.candidate_producer_solving_plausible: separate false/unknown/true; no evidence-free true or claim that missing rights/runtime can be generated

progress.A: local::run returned formation_result after source normalization; source errors do not reach A
progress.D: durable start identity or common-attempt failed/verified status after admission/start
progress.E: actual runtime realization evidence, never a build success assumption
progress.F: actual Rust verification object or receipt; failed outcome alone is not enough
progress.G: fully_satisfied receipt with matching K/D and attempt ID
progress.H: verified route materialization ref; physical bundle/hash inventory checked
